Composition & Indication

Salbutamol Inhaler 100mcg — 200 Doses (Generic for Ventolin®) contains Salbutamol Sulfate 100 mcg per actuation as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 200 Doses at the official 100mcg/dose strength. The standard indication is the management of asthma and bronchospasm relief, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Salbutamol Inhaler 100mcg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
